paragraphs: Bamidbar Rabbah 14:1: he speaks in Resh Lakish’s name; the Radal reads bar Rakta.[^1]

notes.text: The complete Midrash Rabbah — TE Bamidbar Rabbah 14:1 paragraph explicitly has Suma bar Katva speaking in the name of Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish. The Radal’s bar Rakta variant remains Hyman’s report, without a fresh apparatus collation. No additional teachings or figures from the long paragraph are imported.
